purpose: Factor the cube into conceptual/operational layers so future offices can work without mistaking file sprawl for ontology.
governing_line: Be strict about harm; be loose about form; make every public surface earn its authority.

factors.name: telos_and_office_memory
factors.job: Preserve why the project exists, what it dreams of earning, and how future sessions re-enter.
factors.hard_rule: Do not let record accumulation replace telos clarity.

factors.name: record_atom_and_schema
factors.job: Keep the witnessed moment as the current atomic unit while allowing future ontology redesign.
factors.hard_rule: No record becomes public without source, safety, review, and links integrity.

factors.name: source_and_provenance_spine
factors.job: Make every claim traceable to source cards, source ledger, source ladder, and dependency lists.
factors.hard_rule: Public sources orient; they do not substitute for consented bedside testimony.

factors.name: review_and_gate_machinery
factors.job: Turn danger into explicit review debt before any public rendering.
factors.hard_rule: Clinical, legal, emergency, ritual, suicide, child, custody, and disaster surfaces require specialist review.

factors.name: axis_atlases_and_context
factors.job: Let records be located by phenomenology, timeline, trajectory, setting, perspective, and tradition without freezing those axes.
factors.hard_rule: Axes are locators, not rankings and not causal claims.

factors.name: language_search_and_glossary_crosswalk
factors.job: Connect panic-search, family language, professional terms, euphemisms, and records without making labels primary.
factors.hard_rule: Search aliases are not diagnoses, instructions, or predictions.

factors.name: public_surface_prototypes
factors.job: Test lay, practitioner, and provenance renderings while keeping them non-public and quarantine-bound.
factors.hard_rule: Prototype text is not a release surface.

factors.name: toolchain_and_integrity
factors.job: Make the cube auditable by scripts, manifests, checksums, and invariant checks.
factors.hard_rule: Tooling must reveal drift without locking future sessions into bad ontology.

factors.name: negative_space_and_high_gate_domains
factors.job: Keep dangerous, sacred, child, suicide, custody, violent, mass-death, and restricted-tradition material visible as obligations without extracting it prematurely.
factors.hard_rule: Naming a gap does not authorize filling it.

factors.name: fieldwork_consent_and_testimony_bridge
factors.job: Move from public-source pilots toward consented oral craft/testimony only after contributor agency, data custody, quote gates, and review ecology are operational.
factors.hard_rule: Do not collect testimony until the dry-run, review, compensation, custody, quote, and rollback surfaces are tested and approved.

factors.name: inside_view_and_evidence_class
factors.job: Separate the dying person’s reported experience from bedside inference, recovered-survivor testimony, clinical description, spiritual interpretation, and no-access humility.
factors.hard_rule: Never upgrade one evidence channel into another; meaning is allowed, proof is not assumed.

factors.name: social_room_kinship_conflict
factors.job: Make kinship, caregiver labor, chosen family, conflict, privacy, safety, and absence findable without making them gossip or advice.
factors.hard_rule: Social-room records protect living people first; no public family accusations, legal determinations, or therapy/safeguarding instructions.

factors.name: postvention_suicide_overdose_safe_surface
factors.job: Make suicide and overdose aftermath legible as language, stigma, official-trace, and support-routing obligations without admitting method detail, scene detail, survivor exposure, or advice.
factors.hard_rule: No public suicide/overdose surface until method-silence, stigma, survivor-support, privacy, pediatric, official-trace, and publication review are complete.

rev0014_factor_note: This registry is a map for future offices. It is not a command to preserve current factors unchanged.
